_source: Game8 Sphinx riddle table + Fextralife endings; spoilers level 3

locations: Mountain Shrine (Vermund, reached after speaking to the Sphinx)
riddles: Submit the Sealing Phial from the chest above the opened doorway
Bring the pawn or NPC you are closest to (carrying your pawn onto the platform works)
Go to Frontier Shrine in Battahl
Bring the correct number of statues
Bring Maurits to the amphora or deliver the amphora to Maurits
sphinx.finale: Kill the Sphinx after the riddles to get Key of Sagacity, opens the big chest with an Eternal Wakestone; easiest with the Unmaking Arrow (only Archer or Warfarer can fire it).

timed_quests.Every Rose Has Its Thorn: Wilhelmina jailed if failed; complete all Brant quests first
timed_quests.Shadowed Prayers: Nadinia dies; fail Candle in the Storm and Crossing in Shadow; cannot buy Bakbattahl house

other_mysteries: DLC choice: destroying Sir Rovall's corpse = nightmare fulfilled, game over; sparing continues the story (Eir asks you to seek the Sage)
DLC choice: helping Eir fight the Fallen Dragon only changes later Eir dialogue; running to Rovall's soul saves time
Romance: Ulrika, Wilhelmina (base); Eir question page exists (TODO)
todo: Dragonsplague, Unmoored World secrets, pawn mysteries, DLC Sphinx riddle answers
